title: People in your week

locked.title: Others in your operation week
locked.body: Pro shows how many people had their operation in the same week as you. You only ever see a count.

join.title: Join your operation week
join.body: Opt in to be counted with people who had their operation in the same week. Only your operation date, goal and type are shared. Never photos, your name or your clinic.

visible: You are one of {{count}} people in your week
invitation: You're in. A number appears once enough people share your week, so nobody can be singled out.
privacy: Only your operation date, goal and type are shared.

error.offline: You're offline. Try again when you're connected.
error.busy: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
error.generic: Couldn't reach the group. Try again.
